rationale: Author-of-record confirmation of round-2 fix commit d59622b3 (exactly ONE commit atop 44690044). Confinement verified by git diff --name-only 44690044 d59622b3: exactly three files, all internal/next (beads_test.go, ready_gate.go, ready_gate_test.go) — zero overlap with bead 7's surface (cmd/mindspec/next.go, internal/next/guard.go, internal/next/entangle_test.go), exactly as the commit's deviation note claims. Both R3 round-2 asks delivered, each by its preferred option. Ask 1 (metadata-seam, FIXED in-bounds rather than deferred): RecordReadinessOverride (ready_gate.go:116-127) and RollbackReadinessOverride (ready_gate.go:148-155) now wrap mergeMetadataFn's/deleteMetadataKeysFn's errors in bdRenderedError — the correct disposition, since R3's refutation of the round-1 'unarmed via tracedCombined' rationale was right: bead.MergeMetadata/DeleteMetadataKeys read via GetMetadata -> tracedOutput FIRST, so merge-read/delete-read failures carry folded bd stderr today. The wrap adds no message prefix, preserving the documented return-the-raw-error contract; I verified no consumer or test depends on error identity or exact text (cmd/mindspec/next.go:286 renders via %v — message-only, and bdRenderedError.Error() is byte-identical for printable text; TestRecordReadinessOverride_PropagatesWriteFailure asserts only non-nil; no errors.Is-on-sentinel anywhere on these paths), and the chain stays intact via Unwrap regardless. Ask 2 (red-on-revert pins, which my round-2 MINOR finding also flagged — now closed): TestFetchBeadByID_AC11RenderingLeg drives a PATH-shimmed control-bearing fake bd end-to-end through the real RunBD chain and asserts no raw \x1b/\r/\x00 in the rendered error — dropping the wrapper at beads.go's FetchBeadByID site reverts to raw bytes and this test goes red; TestGateReadiness_RenderingLegControlBytesEscaped does the same for ready_gate.go's evaluation wrap via the evaluateReadinessFn seam. Both also pin content survival (depends_on_id present), so they are AC-11 two-leg tests, not escape-only. Verified firsthand in the bead worktree at d59622b3 (clean, byte-identical): gofmt -l clean, go build ./... green, go test -short -count=1 green on internal/bead (6.0s) and internal/next (16.7s) including all new tests. Standing APPROVE confirmed.
